summary: This update cleans up the new tab search bar, improves rapid tab closing, removes the broken cookie import feature, and adds update checking inside Settings.
changes: Removed the microphone and grid buttons from the new tab search bar.
Rapidly closing tabs now waits briefly before resizing the tab strip, so the close button stays easier to hit.
Removed cookie import from Settings because modern browser cookies are encrypted per browser profile and importing them was unreliable.
Added a Settings update page that reads this GitHub update file and shows users what changed before updating.
Kept the latest installer link connected to the official YCB download.
